title: Silicon Valley's Open Source Fear
full_monologue: **Silicon Valley is terrified of open source AI**. Why? Because it's democratizing power. When code is open, anyone can build, innovate, and compete. No more gatekeeping. No more monopolies. But for companies that rely on proprietary models, that’s a threat. Open source AI means innovation can’t be locked behind paywalls. It’s a paradigm shift. And that’s why the big players are watching closely. What do you think? Is open source the future or a risk?
